definitions.explanation: One's inner feeling or emotional state. A somewhat refined way to describe how one feels or the emotional atmosphere.
Used adverbially to mean 'just a little' or 'slightly.' Indicates a very small degree of change or difference.

examples.japanese: {心持|こころも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{陽気|ようき}→陽気：03657_youki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{心持|こころも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あか}るく→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The spring weather brightened my mood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧、⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧わが{家|や}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧とき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{心持|こころも}ち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{格別|かくべつ}→格別：00154_kakubetsu⟧だった。
examples.english: The feeling of arriving home after a trip was something special.

examples.japanese: {心持|こころも}ち⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}せて→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please move it slightly to the left.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{心持|こころも}ち⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{心持|こころも}ち⟦{多|おお}め→多め：28421_oome⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{締|し}まる→引き締まる：15200_hikishimaru⟧。
examples.english: Adding just a touch more salt brings out the flavor.

notes:
USAGE:
In sense 1 (noun), {心持|こころも}ち is a refined alternative to {気持|きも}ち (feeling). It is more literary and introspective.

In sense 2 (adverb), {心持|こころも}ち indicates a very slight degree — smaller than ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ or ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧. It is commonly used when giving instructions that require minute adjustments.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {心持|こころも}ち: feeling (refined); slightly (very small amount)
- {気持|きも}ち: feeling (everyday); slightly (as adverb)
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧: a little (more than {心持|こころも}ち)
- わずか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: slightly, marginally (formal)
